description: Role-based navigation tree for the Microverse GUI. Each role maps to an ordered list of top-level nav items. Items with a 'children' array render as an in-page Subnav tab row on that item's own page (see branding/mv-1.0/design-system/mock-ups/platform_projects_hub_and_admin.html's #subnav) — the top-level nav stays a plain link to the first child; children are NOT a navbar dropdown/popup menu.

nav.label: Accounts
nav.notes: This item was missing from an earlier draft of this config — Navbar.js already had it. Own Accounts, accordion into each Account's Projects, click through to a Project's Tasks (4.6). Renamed from /customer in 4.6 to pair with account-manager's Customers view (now at /projects/manage) over the same AccountsProjectsView component.

nav.label: Orders
nav.notes: Global list, filterable by service. Service detail page links here pre-filtered via ?serviceId=

nav.label: Billing
nav.notes: Global list, filterable by service. Cross-linked with Orders once an order is billed.

nav.label: Analysis queue
nav.notes: Cross-service, filterable by customer. No standalone Services nav item — each queue item deep-links to /services/:id for context.

nav.label: Review queue
nav.notes: Cross-service, filterable by customer. No standalone Services nav item — each queue item deep-links to /services/:id for context.

nav.label: Projects
nav.notes: The contract/delivery unit (see docs/business/1.0/overview.md — 'a Project is the contract unit'). Restored in 4.3; was dropped from an earlier draft of this config in error. Master-detail split view: list of Projects the PM owns (via pm_accounts + service scope), detail shows that Project's Orders/Tasks. Moved from /pm/projects to /projects/list; dropped the former Accounts tab (same ownership-scoped data as this list, just re-grouped — redundant for a PM).

nav.label: Orders
nav.notes: Moved here from platform:admin in 4.3 — PM-scoped (pm_accounts + service scope), not global. Placeholder/dummy page only for 4.3 — real order list functionality + 4.1.2's shared-pool claim (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, see docs/architecture/1.0/business-services.md's 'The task pool') are later-phase work, same 'stub now, build later' pattern as 4.0.3's Services tab. This nav item exists now so the eventual pool UI has a home already reserved under PM, not Admin.

nav.label: Delivery team
nav.notes: List of analysts/reviewers, master-detail split view. Detail shows that person's tasks assigned. No workload/performance metrics yet — deferred to Branch 8's audit-trail work; this is list+detail only for 4.3. Analysts/Reviewers render as an in-page Subnav tab row (DeliveryTeamPage.js), same shape as Admin below — not a navbar dropdown.

nav.label: Bills
nav.notes: Branch 9 — shared route with platform:account-manager (BillsPage.js), deliberately not /pm/bills — rustledger's GET /api/billing/bills scopes the response server-side by caller role instead of the frontend picking a different path. A PM sees only bills they created (rustledger.bills.created_by_id, a Keycloak subject — not email/username, since either can change and would silently orphan old bills from view); they create the bill (amount) but no longer publish it themselves (moved to the AM after this branch's first pass) — see docs/roadmap/1.0/domain-services.md's Branch 9. Distinct from the Orders placeholder above, which is about the order/task pool, not billing.

nav.label: Customers
nav.notes: Account-level view — contacts, services engaged, cross-sell/upsell visibility (see docs/business/1.0/overview.md's Account management section). Master-detail split view: list of Accounts, detail shows that Account's engagement history. Renamed from /am/customers (AmCustomersPage) in 4.6, then /accounts/manage -> /projects/manage — assigning a Project's PM is the defining account-manager action here, hence the /projects prefix even though the list itself starts from Accounts.

nav.label: Billing
nav.notes: Moved here from platform:admin in 4.3 — account-manager scoped, not Admin's. As of 6.2.5, actually ownership-scoped (accounts.account_manager_id), not global across every Account the way Admin's old view was — see docs/roadmap/1.0/domain-services.md's 4.3 resolution note on why 'no table at all' was superseded. Fits the sell/commercial-engagement remit: contract terms (docs/business/1.0/overview.md's payment_terms), invoicing status, live under the role that owns the customer relationship rather than Admin. Currently a stub page (AmBillingPage) regardless of scope.

nav.label: Bills
nav.notes: Branch 9 — shared route with platform:project-manager (BillsPage.js). Unlike this role's ownership-scoped Billing item above (accounts.account_manager_id, 6.2.5), this one is deliberately unscoped — every bill across every service/PM, matching AM's other unscoped views (e.g. GET /accounts) rather than the ownership-scoped exception 6.2.5 carved out. This is where the AM actually publishes/releases a bill a PM created (rustledger's POST .../publish), the action that notifies the customer — a distinct concern from the Billing item's contract/invoicing overview.

nav.label: Admin

children.label: Users
children.notes: Single unscoped list, all account types (customer, analyst, reviewer, project-manager, account-manager, admin) with a role/type filter and column.

nav.notes: Admin as one top-level item; Users/Services/Settings/Audit-log render as an in-page Subnav tab row (AdminPage.js) below the main nav, matching branding/mv-1.0/design-system/mock-ups/platform_projects_hub_and_admin.html's #subnav — not four flat top-level items, and not a navbar dropdown. Same shape as platform:project-manager's Delivery team.
